kind: protocol-abort incident record -- NO scientific verdict
note: The campaign reached G3 and stopped on the frozen fail-closed path: `causal_relation` returned undecided at a G3 stress point, so no result was published. This file records the EVENT. It is not a result, it grades nothing, and no gate may be reported as passed on its basis.

lineage.reservation_ref_retention_reason: the claim is permanent: these streams were opened and may never be reused, so the ref stays as the standing global record

seeds.spent_note: drawn from and observed; retired regardless of the absence of a verdict
seeds.g3: no seed of its own -- G3 inherits G1's accepted points

not_spent.40000301: the withdrawn g3_wrapper scalar was never drawn from and remains unallocated

g1.statistics: unavailable -- computed in memory, never persisted

g2.statistics: unavailable -- computed in memory, never persisted
g2.progress_logging: none -- the frozen runner emits no G2 progress

what_is_not_claimed: that any gate passed, failed, or was inconclusive
that V_S1 is concordant or discordant with the O3 certified interval
any value of the G1 mean, variance, half-width or interval
that the run exhausted or approached either frozen cap

git_stamped.source: commit date of the reservation object, written by git at claim time

runner_log.source: the runner's own perf_counter, printed every 300 s; relative only, no absolute clock

operator_record.source: `date` in the operator's launch wrapper, NOT the runner's clock

caps.bound_note: termination was the fail-closed path, not a cap

inference_not_record.claim: the abort occurred at or very near G3's first clusters
inference_not_record.basis: G1's logged average rate is 1245.8 calls/s; the G1 remainder after the last progress line is 36,736 calls (~29 s) and G2's 2,145,392 calls are ~1,722 s at that rate, totalling ~1,752 s, against the 1,636 s actually available between the last G1 progress line and exit -- so G2 ran slightly faster than G1 and left essentially no time inside G3
inference_not_record.status: arithmetic on logged counters, NOT a recorded fact; the replay diagnostic settles it
inference_not_record.cannot_be_pinned_further: G3's whole span is ~400,000 calls (~5 min), and the runner logs no G3 progress

observability_defects: the v1 runner records no G3 stress-point coordinates, so the failing (r, theta) and leg are unavailable
the v1 runner records no per-leg dt, T_min or err, so the undecided margin is unavailable
the v1 runner emits no G2 progress, so G2's boundary in time is only inferable
the v1 runner publishes NOTHING on a fail-closed abort: fail-closed must mean `no scientific verdict is published`, never `no record is left`
required_before_any_rerun: a write-once incident artifact emitted by the runner itself on every abort path
G3 stress-point observability: coordinates, per-leg dt/T_min/err, returned tri-state, and a cause classification
a G3 contract that accounts for `causal_relation` being tri-state by design (see p14_o4_incident.md)
a new freeze and new G1/G2 scalars -- this run's raw samples and statistics were not preserved, and a replay may never be promoted into a scientific result
